falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at higher levels; this would confirm continuation lower rather than a successful retest

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled fear; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation inconsistent with a bottoming structure and would signal the pattern match has failed

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.75% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below 5,000
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination of flight-to-safety in bonds with equity breakdown would indicate recessionary de-risking rather than the disinflationary soft-landing bottom implied by the August 2024 pattern

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
